title: Cycle evaluation and finite-free zero models: shared interfaces
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let T and J be integer-indexed cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let n be an integer. Write P=Hom^bullet(T,J) [def-pur-hom-complex].  Define a finite-free zero model of a complex T over a ringed site R to mean a roof L -> T and L -> E of quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] with E having zero differentials, zero terms outside a finite interval, and each term isomorphic to the free R-module on ULift(Fin r) for some natural r. For opens V of X and W of V, define F by restriction to V followed by restriction to its over site W [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], termwise. Define the evaluation projection as the (-n,0) component of the fixed product projections [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. A map e:H^n(Hom(T,J)) -> Hom(H^(-n)(T),H^0(J)) satisfies IsHomologyEvaluation if for every open U and cycles phi,z,b in degrees n,-n,0, inclusion of b equal to the projection of inclusion of phi evaluated on inclusion of z implies e([phi])([z])=[b]. These are precisely the existing definitions of lem-sc-homology-evaluation-formal-complex, relocated unchanged.

mathlib_searches.query: internal Hom complex evaluation on cohomology sheaves
A morphism from homology of the internal Hom complex to internal Hom of homology is defined by evaluating cocycles on cycles
mathlib_searches.results: Eight additive-group Hom-complex cohomology declarations, including CochainComplex.HomComplex.homologyAddEquiv; none constructs this sheaf-valued evaluation or proves its local perfection.
Twelve declarations, including homologyIsCokernel and instEpiHomologyπ. Useful universal properties, but no bilinear internal-Hom evaluation theorem.
One Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/Functor.lean match concerning evaluation of a diagram of complexes; no internal-Hom evaluation theorem.
